THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

An allotment of land in total extent of about 0.0053 Hectare depictedin the Advanced Tracing No.Va/VAV/96/047 and dated 30.10.1996prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated at the Village of Vavuniya,Municipal Council Limits Ward No. 1 Villages in the Poonthoddam, inDivisional Secretary's Division of Vavuniya in Vavuniya District inNorthern Province and bounded as follows:
